text.tspan: A Practical Guide to Git for Academic Software Development
Planetary scientists tend to write their own software, and many choose to
without employing version control. Git [1] was developed to help manage
version control for software development, yet it's in acadedmia remains
inconsistent [2, 3]. This work attemts to ease the entry of understanding Git
by providing three different workflows, disigned for the solo-researcher up
to a large collaborative group of 5+ people.
